summary: The Perps tab gains a category pill rail; tapping a pill opens the market list already filtered.

standalone.label: Before: the Perps tab goes straight from the balance actions to Watchlist, with no category pills
After: the category rail renders All / Crypto / Stocks / Commodities from live market data, above Watchlist
Tapping Crypto opens the market list at ?filter=crypto with the Crypto filter already applied
